answer: An attacker launching a voyage of fake identities must fund every vault separately, so costs scale linearly with fleet size while honest agents pay once. Sybil resistance can work through a staked-identity vault: each agent locks collateral before joining, and reputation accrues only across verified epochs. Peers cross-attest randomly, and any identity that fails attestation loses its stake to the ocean of honest participants, making mass forgery economically irrational.
